metadata.title: Space Apps Challenge 2026 - FieldShift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data
metadata.description: Official NASA and USDA dataset attributions, URLs, and plain-English operational roles for the in-app Methodology modal and Alexa Space Apps Project Tab submission.

datasets.name: NASA Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP)
datasets.role_plain_english: Provides high-resolution L3/L4 surface and root-zone soil moisture estimates (9 km). FieldShift uses SMAP data to dynamically monitor water-balance gating, determining optimal cover crop termination windows and preventing pre-plant soil moisture depletion in semi-arid Kansas dryland farms.

datasets.name: NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) IMERG
datasets.role_plain_english: Delivers sub-daily gridded precipitation rates and extreme rainfall tracking via IMERG. FieldShift uses GPM precipitation pulses to evaluate soil infiltration capacity, schedule cover crop planting after late-summer rains, and model flood/drought risks across the 100th Meridian gradient.

datasets.name: NASA Ecosystem Spaceborne Thermal Radiometer Experiment on Space Station (ECOSTRESS)
datasets.role_plain_english: Measures plant land surface temperature and Evaporative Stress Index (ESI) at 70-meter resolution. FieldShift utilizes ECOSTRESS to detect canopy thermal stress during intense July heatwaves, optimizing deficit irrigation and assessing cover crop cooling benefits.

datasets.name: NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER)
datasets.role_plain_english: Supplies daily meteorological variables including minimum/maximum temperature, solar radiation, growing degree days (GDD), and frost probabilities. FieldShift integrates NASA POWER to model crop phonology progression and thermal accumulation across benchmark farm counties.

datasets.name: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer (CDL)
datasets.role_plain_english: Provides 30-meter annual crop-specific land cover classifications across the CONUS. FieldShift uses CDL crop codes (Corn: 1, Cotton: 2, Sorghum: 4, Soybeans: 5, Spring Wheat: 23, Winter Wheat: 24) to classify field boundaries and map annual crop rotation sequences.

datasets.name: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Geographic Database (SSURGO)
datasets.role_plain_english: Delivers high-resolution soil survey data including available water capacity, organic matter content, texture, and hydrologic soil groups. FieldShift pairs SSURGO data with SMAP and GPM to model root-zone water holding capacity and nitrogen mineralization rates.

datasets.name: USDA WASDE & NASS Agricultural Prices & Yields
datasets.role_plain_english: Publishes official Season-Average Farm Prices (SAFP), monthly producer prices, and state/county crop production baselines. FieldShift incorporates 2026 WASDE commodity prices and NASS/RMA yields to calculate net economic returns and cover crop cost-benefit ratios.
